title: The Best Wood for CNC Relief Carving: One Design Carved in Eight Species
excerpt: We carved the same whitetail buck in cherry, walnut, maple, basswood, white oak, poplar, sapele and pine, and photographed them side by side. Which woods hold detail, which blotch, which fight the cutter, and what each one costs, so you can pick a board with your eyes open.
seo_title: Best Wood for CNC Relief Carving: 8 Species Compared (Same Design)
seo_description: The best wood for CNC relief carving, compared on one design: cherry, black walnut, hard maple, basswood, white oak, poplar, sapele and pine. Detail, tear-out, blotching, finishing behaviour and cost for each.

email.subject: The same carving in eight woods, side by side
email.intro:
Every guide says "use cherry or walnut" and never shows you why. So we carved the same whitetail buck in eight species, oiled them all the same, and photographed them in a row.

The differences are bigger than you would think. Maple holds hair lines that basswood softens; oak's grain runs straight through the deer's face; pine tears out at every antler tip. The new guide walks through all eight with what each holds, what each costs and how each one finishes.
